{{Top|leg}}
A '''Bank''' was a type of fence used in [[swoopchasing]]. Bank fences were built into an existing natural formation that had either an ascending or descending slope, or sometimes even both. Individual Bank fences had an additional obstacle added to it, forcing the riders to either accelerate or decelerate as they approached. Specific types of Bank fences included the [[Grand Moff Bank]], the [[Gravity Well (swoopchasing)|Gravity Well]], the [[Pop'N'Drop]] and the [[Suicide Peak]].<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
